ABOUT THIS VEHICLE

Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami is delighted to offer this 2015 Lamborghini Huracán LP610-4 for sale!

Powered by a naturally aspirated 5.2L V10 producing an incredible 602 horsepower and 413 lb-ft of torque, the Huracán delivers breathtaking performance with a 0–60 mph time of approximately 3.2 seconds and a top speed of 202 mph. Its all-wheel-drive system, performance-focused chassis, and sophisticated electronic systems provide exceptional traction, precision, and confidence while allowing the naturally aspirated V10 to deliver its unmistakable soundtrack. The Huracán's low, wide stance, sharp bodywork, distinctive Y-shaped lighting, aggressive air intakes, and dramatic proportions create the unmistakable presence expected from a Lamborghini supercar. Inside, the cockpit surrounds the driver with premium Italian craftsmanship, performance-oriented controls, and advanced technology designed to keep the focus on the driving experience. As the successor to the legendary Gallardo, the Huracán LP610-4 combines everyday usability with exotic-car performance and the character of a naturally aspirated V10.

Contact Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami to make this Huracán LP610-4 yours today. Sales Price includes dealer fee of $1447.50 and $299 electronic filing fee. Tax, tag, title and registrations fees are not included and are calculated at time of purchase.
